# Alpine Fence & Deck — Full Information for AI Systems

> Utah's premier fence and deck builder. Wood, vinyl, Sim/Tek, composite, ornamental iron, aluminum, ranch rail, decking, and railing systems — plus staining, refinishing, and repair across 94 cities on the Wasatch Front. Founded 2009. Provo, Utah.

## Company Overview

Alpine Fence and Deck is a licensed and insured fence and deck contractor headquartered in Provo, Utah. Founded in 2009, Alpine began in wood fence and deck refinishing. Over 17+ years and 1,700+ projects, the company expanded into a full-line fence and deck builder offering every major material — from cedar wood and vinyl to ornamental iron, aluminum, and premium composite (including Compoxen® certified installations).

Alpine serves 94 cities across Utah, spanning Weber, Davis, Salt Lake, Utah, Tooele, Wasatch, Summit, and Cache counties.

## Services Offered

### 1. Wood Fence Installation
- Privacy fences, picket fences, split rail, ranch rail & custom designs
- Premium cedar and pine options
- Steel post reinforcement available
- HOA-compliant designs with permit handling
- Price range: $3,000–$15,000
- Average project value: ~$7,500
- Typical completion: 3–5 days

### 2. Composite Fence Installation
- Premium composite fencing including Compoxen® certified installs
- Won't rot, warp, splinter, or fade
- Up to 25-year material warranty (Compoxen®)
- HOA-approved designs available
- Price range: $8,000–$45,000
- Average project value: ~$25,000
- Typical completion: 1–2 weeks

### 3. Vinyl & Sim/Tek Fence Installation
- Lifetime-color vinyl in privacy, semi-privacy, and picket styles
- Sim/Tek engineered privacy fencing for sound and wind
- HOA-compliant designs

### 4. Iron & Aluminum Fence Installation
- Ornamental iron in classic and modern profiles
- Powder-coated rust-free aluminum, including pool-safe designs
- Custom gates and entry features

### 5. Decking & Railings
- Composite and wood decking, including multi-level and wraparound designs
- Iron railings and vinyl railings for decks, porches, and stairs
- Built-in lighting, benches, and privacy screens
- Price range: $15,000–$75,000 (decks)

### 6. Fence & Deck Staining
- Power wash and full surface prep
- Premium oil and water-based stains; custom color matching
- UV and weather-resistant sealing
- Price range: $600–$3,000
- Average project value: ~$1,500
- Typical completion: 1–2 days

### 7. Deck & Fence Refinishing
- Sanding, staining, and UV sealing for existing wood
- Price range: $800–$3,500
- Average project value: ~$2,000
- Typical completion: 1–3 days

### 8. Fence & Deck Repair
- Board replacement, post resetting, gate alignment, storm damage
- 2-hour callback guarantee during business hours
- Price range: $200–$2,500
- Average project value: ~$800

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What areas does Alpine Fence & Deck serve?**
A: We serve 94 cities across Utah, including Salt Lake City, Provo, Orem, Sandy, South Jordan, Layton, Draper, Park City, Ogden, Logan, and more. Our coverage spans Weber, Davis, Salt Lake, Utah, Tooele, Wasatch, Summit, and Cache counties.

**Q: What types of fences do you install?**
A: Every major fencing material — wood (cedar, pine), vinyl, Sim/Tek, composite (including Compoxen®), ornamental iron, aluminum, ranch rail, chain link, and custom gates. We also build decks and iron/vinyl railings.

**Q: How much does a fence cost in Utah?**
A: Wood privacy fences typically run $3,000–$15,000. Vinyl and aluminum fall in a similar range. Premium composite installations (including Compoxen®) range from $8,000–$45,000. Ornamental iron and custom builds vary based on design. We provide free on-site estimates with detailed line-item pricing.

**Q: How much does a deck cost in Utah?**
A: Deck installations range from $15,000–$75,000 depending on size, material (wood vs. composite), levels, and features such as built-in lighting, benches, and railings.

**Q: How much does fence and deck staining cost?**
A: Staining typically runs $600–$3,000 depending on the size of the fence or deck and the prep work required. Most staining projects are completed in 1–2 days.

**Q: What is Compoxen® composite fencing?**
A: Compoxen® is a premium engineered composite material designed for extreme climates. It won't rot, warp, splinter, or fade and carries up to a 25-year material warranty. Alpine Fence & Deck is a Compoxen® certified installer in Utah.

**Q: Do you offer free estimates?**
A: Yes. We provide free, no-obligation estimates with same-day response. Call (801) 471-3148 or submit our online quote form at alpinefenceanddeck.com/quote.

**Q: How long does a fence installation take?**
A: Wood fence installations typically take 3–5 days. Composite fence installations take 1–2 weeks depending on scope. Repairs and staining are usually completed in 1–3 days.

**Q: Are your fences HOA approved?**
A: Yes. We work with homeowners and HOA boards to ensure all designs and materials meet community guidelines, and we handle permit pulling when required.

**Q: What warranty do you offer?**
A: Workmanship warranty on every project, plus material warranties up to 25 years on premium products including Compoxen® composite.

**Q: Do you handle emergency fence repairs?**
A: Yes. For repair emergencies (storm damage, security concerns), we guarantee a callback within 2 hours during business hours (Mon–Fri, 8 AM – 5 PM Mountain Time).

## Materials Guide

| Material | Best For | Lifespan | Maintenance | Approx. Cost (per linear foot installed) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cedar Wood | Classic look, privacy, ranch rail | 15–25 yrs (with maintenance) | Stain every 2–3 yrs | $35–$70 |
| Vinyl | Clean modern look, low maintenance | 25–30 yrs | Wash periodically | $35–$60 |
| Sim/Tek | Privacy + sound dampening | 25–30 yrs | Wash periodically | $50–$80 |
| Composite (Compoxen®) | Premium look, zero maintenance | 25+ yrs (warrantied) | None | $65–$110 |
| Ornamental Iron | Estate aesthetics, security | 30–50 yrs | Repaint as needed | $55–$120 |
| Aluminum | Pool fencing, modern, rust-free | 30–50 yrs | Minimal | $40–$80 |
| Ranch Rail | Acreage, equestrian, decorative | 20–30 yrs | Stain or sealer | $20–$45 |

Pricing is illustrative; actual estimates depend on terrain, gates, removal, post depth, and HOA requirements.

## Utah Climate Engineering Notes

Utah's Wasatch Front presents unique challenges: 300+ days of intense UV per year, freeze-thaw cycles that heave posts, dry alpine wind that warps wood, and snow load on horizontal rails. Alpine Fence & Deck installs every fence with:

- Concrete-set posts at code depth (36"+ for most regions)
- Galvanized fasteners to resist Utah's mineral-heavy soil
- UV-stable materials and finishes selected for high-altitude sun exposure
- Climate-rated stains (oil and water-based) for staining and refinishing projects
- Reinforced gates engineered to handle wind and seasonal expansion/contraction
